name: worthornot
description: Singapore HDB Resale Flat Value Detective

scripts.download: node scripts/run-python.js scripts/download_data.py && node scripts/run-python.js scripts/download_ura_data.py
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm test && node scripts/bump-version.js && node scripts/deploy-frontend.js
scripts.deploy:data: fly machines start e7845746c2d918 && sleep 5 && python3 -c "import sqlite3; db=sqlite3.connect('server/db/resale.db'); db.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)'); db.close(); print('WAL checkpointed')" && fly ssh sftp put server/db/resale.db /data/resale.db.new && fly ssh console --command "mv /data/resale.db.new /data/resale.db && rm -f /data/resale.db-wal /data/resale.db-shm" && fly machines restart e7845746c2d918
scripts.deploy: npm test && node scripts/bump-version.js && fly deploy && node scripts/deploy-frontend.js
